description: Prior-DWI share of drivers with BAC >= .08 by state (measured BAC only; measured plus imputed), with driver counts and a flag for states with fewer than 100 drivers
method: Measured BAC = a test result in FARS person.ALC_RES (0-940 thousandths; 940 = .94 or greater); NHTSA's implicates fill untested drivers.  'measured only' counts a driver as BAC >= .08 only with a measured result >= .08 (observed counts, no imputation SE); 'all' / 'imputed' use the 10 implicates (mean, MI SE sqrt(1.1 * between-implicate variance)); state = FARS STATE; 'small' = fewer than 100 such drivers
